title: A Very Simple Horror Modpack
description: Just some horror mods with out the interference of Dwellers. With some player variety using mods such as Vampirism and Werewolves.
body:
### What is this modpack?

Explore a vast environment and escape from looming threats in the dark. 

Do you want to fight back against the creatures of the night? Become one.

A **horror** themed modpack that includes mods meant to make the game scarier and feel more daunting, days are short while night are long and dangerous. While this is a horror modpack you will **NOT** find any dwellers, this is due to how common the use of dweller mobs as 'horror' has gotten into the modding scene. Also includes mods such as **Vampirism** and **Werewolves** for player diversity and better use in multiplayer.

### General Info

This modpack uses **Simple Voice Chat** and other mods that use it! It is recommended to use this when playing!

This was originally a modpack made for me and my friends to play. It works good on servers. Also has mods to help with server management.

_DO NOT BE AFRAID TO CHANGE CONTROLS WHEN YOU FIRST LOG IN, THEY WERE MINE DUE TO CONFIG SAVING WITH CERTAIN MODS_

### Requirements?

Me and my friends played this modpack with at least **12gb of RAM**. Take that to heart when trying to run it.

### Credits

This modpack contains **Cosmetic Armor Reworked** which can be found here:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cosmetic-armor-reworked

This modpack contains **Simple Voice Chat** which can be found here:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simple-voice-chat

This modpack contains **Lucky's Spelunker's Charm II** which can be found here:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/spelunkers-charm-ii
